title: Pan-Seared Canadian Fish
description: A simple and flavorful dish featuring fresh Canadian fish, cooked to perfection with a hint of lemon and herbs.
instructions: Season the Canadian fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the fish for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until cooked through.
While the fish is cooking, mix the fresh ocean herbs and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Remove the fish from the oven and brush the herb-lemon mixture on top of each fillet.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional herbs if desired.
